description: Coerce and relay NTLM authentication for lateral movement and privilege escalation (relay to SMB, LDAP, ADCS). Load in an AD network with a foothold, on "NTLM relay", "responder", "coerce", no/absent SMB signing, or PetitPotam/PrinterBug. Signals: LLMNR/NBT-NS traffic, SMB signing off, MS-RPRN/EFSRPC.
